description: Industrial Edge Middleware - Multi-Tenant Data Acquisition System with Docker, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, InfluxDB, and MQTT (Mosquitto). Supports S7 and Modbus TCP drivers with real-time alarm detection and time-series historization.

userStories.title: Create PostgreSQL database schema for organizational hierarchy
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to create the database tables for the multi-tenant organizational structure.
acceptanceCriteria: Create organizations table with id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ
Create sites table with id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, org_id INT REFERENCES organizations(id), name TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ
Create areas table with id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, site_id INT REFERENCES sites(id), name TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ
All Foreign Key constraints are properly defined
Typecheck passes (Go code compiles)
userStories.notes: Created migrations/001_init_schema.sql with organizations, sites, areas tables with proper indexes

userStories.title: Create PostgreSQL database schema for gateways and tags
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to create the database tables for gateways and tags with all constraints.
acceptanceCriteria: Create gateways table with id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, area_id INT REFERENCES areas(id), name TEXT NOT NULL, driver_type VARCHAR(20) CHECK (driver_type IN ('S7', 'MODBUS_TCP')), connection_config JSONB NOT NULL, scan_rate_ms INT DEFAULT 1000, enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ

Create tags table with id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, gateway_id INT REFERENCES gateways(id), code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, alias VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, data_type VARCHAR(20) CHECK (data_type IN ('INT', 'REAL', 'BOOL', 'DINT')), historize BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, historize_deadband FLOAT DEFAULT 0.0, alarm_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, alarm_threshold FLOAT, alarm_operator VARCHAR(2) CHECK (alarm_operator IN ('>', '<', '=')), alarm_priority INT DEFAULT 1 CHECK (alarm_priority BETWEEN 1 AND 5), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ

Create alarms table with id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, tag_id INT REFERENCES tags(id), state VARCHAR(20) CHECK (state IN ('ACTIVE', 'RTN', 'ACKNOWLEDGED', 'CLEAR')), message TEXT, triggered_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, acknowledged_at TIMESTAMPTZ, cleared_at TIMESTAMPTZ
All Foreign Key constraints are properly defined
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created gateways, tags, alarms tables in migrations/001_init_schema.sql with proper indexes
